requires_testing.description:
RequiresTesting: required (true/false) only for SMR + SAE multibanda
certificate when the company allows SMR without testing; null otherwise.

carriers_tested.description:
CarriersTested are the carriers the engineer checked. SIMLOCK results are
only required for these.

evidence.description: Evidence carries all three screenshots: sw_version, pop_up, cb_history.

with_delivery.description: WithDelivery when true: perform move but do not send notification email.

profile.description: Opcional - se crea automáticamente si no existe

client_id_locked.description: ClientIDLocked: client_id can no longer change (certificates issued).

oabi_certificates_issued.description:
OabiCertificatesIssued counts this company's shipment controls with an
OABI certificate issued.

oabi_missing.description:
OabiMissing lists the missing fields among client_id, rut,
razon_social, address. Empty means complete.

users_count.description: UsersCount counts users whose company or clients include this company.

active.description: Active is false only when explicitly deactivated.

default_for.description: DefaultFor lists the modules fixed to this country.

used_in.description:
UsedIn lists the modules with records of this country:
"homologation", "tracking", "shipment_control".

users_count.description: UsersCount counts users whose countries list includes it.

used_count.description: UsedCount counts devices whose mapped field equals this value exactly.

device_incomplete.description:
DeviceIncomplete is the part of Invalid with reason device_incomplete:
valid new IMEIs not saved because their device could not be saved whole.

phase_states.description: PhaseStates: pending | done | skipped per phase.

report_date.description:
ReportDate is when the automatic report was first generated (the moment
the "report available" email goes out); null until then.

report_status.description:
ReportStatus is the automatic report's state: "draft", "generated" or
empty when the report screen was never opened. Independent of
TestReportUrl, which holds the manually uploaded report of the old flow.

requires_testing.description: RequiresTesting: null unless SMR without testing applies to the request.

smr_validation.description: SmrValidation: only for SMR without testing; null otherwise.

includes_simlock.description:
Scope flags let the frontend show or hide whole blocks without
re-deriving the process-type rules.

validation.description:
Validation drives the completion bar, the section sidebar, the blocker
panel and the exceptions list. It is computed server-side so the
frontend never has to re-derive what is mandatory.

fm_radio.description:
FMRadio comes from device.communication_radio: "Supported",
"Not Supported", or "" when the device does not declare it.

supports_gsm.description:
Device technology support drives which SAE technology tests are
applicable; unsupported ones are forced to N/A.

status_view.description:
StatusView is "Approved" / "Rejected" for closed controls, otherwise
the status label ("Ongoing").

verdict.description: Verdict of a closed control: "approved" | "rejected" ("" while open).

fm_radio.description: FMRadio is the device's communication_radio (null when not set).

stamp_code.description: StampCode comes from last_report ("" when there is none).

Bearer.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
Bearer.name: Authorization
